# Leandro Gabriel, technical writing portfolio

> Portfolio of Leandro Gabriel Oliveira de Souza, senior technical writer with 6+ years of experience writing API references, integration guides, and support documentation for Itaú (PIX APIs), Sephora LATAM, L'Oréal France, and Crane Worldwide.

The site has two projects. EnergyGrid is a fictional utility platform documented for three audiences: backend engineers, people installing hardware at home, and support agents. PIX is a documentation set for Brazil's instant-payments system with one page of each Diátaxis type. Every page is one Diátaxis type: tutorial, how-to guide, reference, or explanation. Prose follows the Google developer documentation style guide, checked in CI by Vale.

The full text of every page below is in [llms-full.txt](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/llms-full.txt), rebuilt on every deploy.

## About the portfolio

- [Home](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/): Overview of the portfolio and its work samples.
- [Methodology](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/methodology): How the site applies the Google style guide and Diátaxis, and where the author has applied them at work. (Explanation)
- [Writing guideline](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/writing-guideline): The site's style guide: voice, tone, words to avoid, formatting, and a pre-publication checklist. (Reference)
- [Architecture decision records](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/adr): The tooling and content decisions behind the site, one page each. (Explanation)
- [Using these docs with AI](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/using-these-docs-with-ai): How the site is structured for chatbots and retrieval pipelines. (Explanation)

## EnergyGrid (fictional utility platform)

- [EnergyGrid overview](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs): Products, audiences, and where to start. (Explanation)
- [Tutorial: first integration](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/tutorial-first-integration): Sandbox credentials, customer sync, and binding a device in about 30 minutes. (Tutorial)
- [Integration guide](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/integration-guide): OAuth and OIDC, customer sync, bulk usage and billing data, billing cycles, rates, and device binding. (How-to and explanation)
- [PowerBox API reference](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/api/powerbox-api): Utility-to-platform API: login, customer sync, and device binding. Generated from OpenAPI. (Reference)
- [Usage API reference](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/api/usage-api/energygrid-usage-api): Customer-facing read API: usage, budgets, and insights. Generated from OpenAPI. (Reference)
- [DataBridge Hub installation guide](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/databridge/databridge-installation-guide-atlas-insight): Installing the DataBridge Hub at home. (How-to)
- [SmartLink Plug installation guide](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/smartlink/smartlink-installation-guide): Installing the SmartLink Plug at home. (How-to)
- [BillSense AI overview](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/billsense-ai/overview): What the AI bill analysis feature does and its limits. (Explanation)
- [BillSense AI troubleshooting](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/billsense-ai/troubleshooting): Symptoms, causes, and fixes for support agents. (Reference)
- [Data dictionary](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/data-dictionary): Data sources, dependencies, and storage for each integration type. (Reference)

## PIX (Brazil's instant payments)

- [About PIX](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/pix/about-pix): How PIX works and why its API is designed the way it is. (Explanation)
- [Tutorial: first payment](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/pix/tutorial-first-payment): Create a charge, pay it in the sandbox, receive the webhook, and reconcile. (Tutorial)
- [How-to: handle webhooks](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/pix/how-to-handle-webhooks): Authentication, fast responses, deduplication, and recovery for a production webhook listener. (How-to)
- [PIX API reference](https://l-g99921.github.io/tw-portfolio/docs/api/pix-api/instant-payments-api-pix-sample): Anonymized sample based on the public PIX PSP standard. Generated from OpenAPI. (Reference)
